data.name: Daily War Online
data.detailed_description:
Daily War is an island-builder battler with a slow heartbeat and a sharp edge.

Build your island. Place tiles into a growing island fortress — spawners, defenses, and structures that fight for you. Every placement is validated and permanent until you choose to rebuild.

Declare war. Challenge ELO-matched opponents from around the world. The better you do, the bigger your island grows and the tougher your rivals become.

Play your card. Before each attack, draw a battle card that bends the rules of that single fight — then commit to the hand you're dealt.

One war a day. Battles resolve in a daily rollover and play back as a replay you can watch and review. No grinding, no twitch reflexes — just one decision that matters.

Fly your colors. Customize your flag, climb the ladder, and make every war count.

IMPORTANT NOTE: This game offers about 5-10 minutes of gameplay per day since it is an asynchronous multiplayer experience. In the future, leagues will be available with various shorter time frames for people who prefer to run multiple battles per day.
